voice_line: Hi there! I'm one of the voices this model can make up on its own, and I'm ready to read anything you write.

samples.title: Voice cloning
samples.text: The lighthouse keeper climbed the last step, set her lantern on the sill, and watched the storm roll in across the bay. Somewhere below, a bell began to ring.

samples.title: Inline cues
samples.text: [whispers] Don't move. I think it heard us. [pause] [sighs] Oh, it's only the cat. [laughs] You should have seen your face.

samples.title: Two speakers
samples.text:
<|speaker:0|> Did you remember the tickets?
<|speaker:1|> [laughs] I thought you had them!
<|speaker:0|> [sighs] Then we're watching the concert from the parking lot.

samples.title: Emotion
samples.text: [excited] We did it! It actually works! [shouting] Everybody, come and look at this, right now!

samples.title: Five speakers
samples.text:
<|speaker:0|> [dramatic dungeon master] You enter the dark cave. A dragon sleeps on a pile of gold.
<|speaker:1|> [brave, too loud] I attack the dragon!
<|speaker:0|> [pause] It's asleep. Are you sure?
<|speaker:2|> [panicking] Don't attack the dragon!
<|speaker:3|> [chill, slow] I'm gonna try to seduce the dragon.
<|speaker:4|> [nerdy, excited] Actually, by the rules, the dragon gets a perception check.
<|speaker:1|> [rolls dice] Natural one.
<|speaker:0|> [sighs] You trip over the gold. The dragon wakes up.
<|speaker:3|> [unbothered] Hey there, big guy.
<|speaker:2|> [screaming] WE'RE ALL GONNA DIE!

samples.title: Singing
samples.text: [singing, grand operatic] Oh toast, my golden toast, you're the bread I love the most! [singing softly] Crispy edges, warm and brown, finest slice in all the town. [spoken, alarmed] Wait, is it burning? [sniffs] It's burning. [singing dramatically, falling apart] Oh toast, my blackened toast, now you're just a crunchy ghost! [sobbing] Why must all good things char?

samples.title: Portuguese
samples.text: [Brazilian football fan, building tension, Portuguese] Vai, vai, vai, vai! Ele passou por um, passou por dois, [shouting] olha o chute! [pause] [screaming with total joy] GOOOOOOOOL! GOL! GOL DO BRASIL! [laughing hysterically] Eu não acredito! Que golaço! [crying with emotion] Pai, você viu isso? Você viu? [hugging, breathless] Trinta anos esperando por esse momento, trinta anos!

samples.title: Auctioneer
samples.text: [fast-talking auctioneer, rapid fire] Alright folks, lot number forty-seven, one slightly haunted rocking chair, do I hear ten, ten dollar, ten dollar, now fifteen, fifteen, fifteen in the back, now twenty, twenty-dollar-bid-now-twenty-five, will-ya-give-me-twenty-five, twenty-five to the lady with the ghost, [pause] wait, ma'am, is that the ghost bidding? [nervous laugh] Ha. Okay. Thirty from the ghost. Going once, going twice, [gasps] the chair is rocking by itself. SOLD! [whispering] Please take it away immediately.

samples.title: Pirate GPS
samples.text: [gruff pirate captain, very loud] Arrr! In two hundred meters, turn starboard onto Maple Street! [pause] Ye missed it, ye landlubber! [sighs] Recalculating. [grumbling] Recalculating me whole life, I am. [cheerful again] Arrr! Proceed for three nautical miles, then keep the parking lot on yer port side. [suspicious] Why be we stopping at a drive-through? [delighted] Ooh, get the fish sandwich. [whispering] For the crew.

samples.title: Laughing fit
samples.text: [trying to tell a story, already giggling] Okay, okay, so we're at the restaurant, and the waiter comes over, and Mark, Mark goes— [laughs] no, wait, wait, I can do this. [deep breath] Mark tries to order in French, right, and instead of "the duck", he says— [bursts out laughing] he says— [wheezing] I can't, I can't breathe— [laughing uncontrollably] he asked the waiter to KISS HIM— [gasping] and the waiter said "maybe later"! [crying from laughing] Oh my God, my stomach hurts.

samples.title: On hold
samples.text: [soothing automated voice] Your call is important to us. Please stay on the line. [pause] Your call is important to us. Please stay on the line. [pause] Your call is very important to us. [slightly strained] Please. Stay. On the line. [pause] Your call is… [voice breaking] honestly, your call is the only thing that gives my life meaning. [sobbing] Please don't hang up. [pause] [suddenly calm and robotic] Your call is important to us.

samples.title: Sneeze
samples.text: [distinguished professor, giving a lecture] And so, in conclusion, the fundamental theorem demonstrates that— [inhales sharply] ah… [pause] ah… [pause] AH… [pause] [relieved] nope, it's gone. As I was saying, the theorem demonstrates— [inhales] ah… AH… [sneezes] ACHOO! [sneezes] ACHOO! [sneezes] ACHOO! [sniffs] [dignified] …that the integral converges. Class dismissed.

samples.title: Bedtime story
samples.text: [gentle bedtime storyteller] Once upon a time, in a cozy little village, there lived a fluffy bunny named Biscuit. Biscuit loved carrots, and sunshine, and his best friend the moon. [pause] One night, Biscuit looked up at the moon, and the moon <whisper>looked back.</whisper> [pause] [slowly] It blinked. [whispering] It smiled with too many teeth. <slow>And it said: Biscuit… come outside.</slow> [suddenly cheerful] The end! Goodnight, sweetie!

samples.title: 4 a.m. lullaby
samples.text: [exhausted new parent, whispering] Shh, shh, shh. It's okay. It's okay, little bean. [sighs] It's four in the morning. Daddy has a meeting in five hours. [humming softly] Mm-hm-hmm. [whispering] You're so loud for something so small. [pause] [yawning] Okay. Okay, look, I'll make you a deal. You sleep, and I'll— [pause] [quietly, amazed] Oh. You're asleep. [barely audible] Don't move. Nobody move. [softly] I love you, you little goblin.
